name: Yuri Fidget Spinners
source:
From Otakuthon's 2017 Yuri Game Jam panel, this game's plot and dialogue  was created through audience suggestion as part of a game making demonstration. Play the game in it's full glory! 

[From [url=https://spacegalore.itch.io/yuri-fidget-spinner] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
来自Otakuthon 2017年Yuri Game Jam小组，该游戏的情节和对话是根据观众的建议创建的，作为游戏制作演示的一部分。尽情享受游戏的荣耀吧！

[来自[url=https://spacegalore.itch.io/yuri-fidget-spinner] itch.io[/url]]
